explanation: The statement is about TauCeti-only notions: `RootPairing.Base.negRoots` (TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/Positive.lean) and `RootPairing.dominantChamber` (TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/Chamber.lean). Searching Mathlib's Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem tree for `negRoots`, `posRoots`, `dominantChamber`, `Chamber`, and for any sign statement about `RootPairing.coroot'` (patterns such as `coroot' … ≤ 0`, `0 ≤ … coroot'`) yields nothing: Mathlib's positivity API is formulated with `RootPairing.Base.IsPos`/`height` (Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/Base.lean, section `PositiveRoots`) and never restricts the sign of `P.coroot' i` on a chamber (it has no chambers at all). Hence there is no Mathlib declaration stating this result, nor one from which it would follow in one or two lines.
